prompt:
Create ONE final high-information-density premium Chinese product introduction poster. Product new name: “思维架构师”, English “PYRAMID ARCHITECT”. Brand aesthetic: sophisticated Apple keynote technology launch, silver-white backdrop, black clean contemporary sans-serif Chinese typography, subtle ice-blue/lavender glass highlights, elegant editorial alignment, thin separators and rounded translucent cards. Crisp text, highest native resolution supported, tall portrait 2:3. Most of the poster should be useful information, readable full capability descriptions, not dominated by decoration. One restrained beautiful optical glass layered pyramid in top right occupying at most 15% of area. No mountains or scenery. No unrelated logos. No Codex, WorkBuddy, ChatGPT, Claude, installation, commands, prompt examples, QR code or URLs. It is only an impressive complete product introduction, not a usage tutorial.
Use only the following exact copy in intelligently designed hierarchy:
Eyebrow “PYRAMID ARCHITECT”
Large product name “思维架构师”
Headline “架构思考，驾驭表达。”
Positioning “基于金字塔原理，贯通问题分析、论证构建、内容呈现与方法内化。”
Principles ribbon “结论先行 · 以上统下 · 归类分组 · 逻辑递进”
Section title “八大能力，覆盖完整表达场景”
Eight compact but easily readable feature cards in a 2-column by 4-row grid, bold heading and body below:
“01 短文与汇报” / “邮件、周报、摘要与简短说明；提炼重点、结论和请求。”
“02 长文与报告” / “搭提纲、组织章节、展开方案；重构材料与论证层次。”
“03 PPT 故事线” / “串联整场主线，规划逐页观点、证据位置与讲述要点。”
“04 问题与决策分析” / “界定现状与目标，拆解原因假设、验证路径与比较标准。”
“05 逻辑审阅” / “检查中心观点、上下支撑、同层分组与顺序，给出针对性修法。”
“06 来源与数据核对” / “对照材料核对数字、口径与限定条件，区分事实、推断和计划。”
“07 日常沟通” / “商量安排、解释选择、请求帮助、说明误会；保留自然语气。”
“08 方法学习与练习” / “理解 SCQA、MECE、归纳与演绎，在真实表达中练习迁移。”
Section title “让每一次表达，都积累为自己的能力”
Four small learning-value columns or cards:
“方法有出处” / “点明实际使用的原理与对应章节。”
“原理讲得明” / “结合成稿，解释组织方式与作用。”
“迁移到生活” / “给出日常可复用的思考提示。”
“逐步独立运用” / “简短复盘，按需练习，减少对代写的依赖。”
Closing bold line “一份清楚的结果，一小段有用的复盘。”
Footer small but legible “PPT 提供内容结构与故事线；事实核对依赖实际材料与可用工具。”
Ensure eight capability cards plus four learning-value points ALL present; do not omit content. No false performance stats or unsupported guarantees. No how-to. Visual quality should feel like a complete premium product spec sheet, information-dense yet clearly hierarchical and readable, not overly tiny text.
